settings.title: Settings
settings.goalText: What do you want to do in Chinese?
settings.goalPlaceholder: e.g. survive a trip to Beijing
settings.soundHint: Companion voice lines and duel listening prompts play out loud.

landing.tagline: Talk your way through a Chinese city with a companion by your side. Every conversation is practice; every practice grows your DNA.
landing.featWorldDesc: Roam the streets, restaurants and train stations of a living city. Talk to NPCs and survive real situations.
landing.featVoiceDesc: Speak out loud. Your companion reacts to your tones, words and pace — no typing required.
landing.featDnaDesc: Nine live skills build a profile of how you learn, with daily missions that target your weak spots.
landing.featCasesDesc: Solve detective cases in Chinese: listen to witnesses, spot the contradiction, name the culprit.
landing.featDuelsDesc: Challenge another learner 1-vs-1: the same questions, the same time, the result decided by the server.
landing.featCompanionsDesc: From Zen capybaras to wise owls — each one teaches with a different style and voice.
landing.hskDisclaimer: No affiliation with the official HSK exam — ChineseVerse only estimates your preparation readiness.

auth.registerSub: Pick a companion later — first, let's get you set up.

dashboard.onARoll: You're on a roll — keep talking.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.subtitle: Real HSK 3.0 words. Practice a level to build mastery — results feed your DNA, quests and review queue.

dna.title: Your Learning DNA
dna.subtitle: Nine strands measured from every interaction. Build the weak ones — daily quests and companions will adapt.

roadmap.title: HSK roadmap
roadmap.advancedStageHint: HSK 7/8/9 share one real advanced vocabulary/Hanzi/grammar pool, shown here as three progress stages.
roadmap.note: Estimates your HSK preparation readiness. ChineseVerse is not affiliated with the official HSK exam.

quests.title: Daily quests
quests.subtitle: Generated from your DNA every day. Complete them to feed your companion.
quests.empty: Nothing today. Take a walk around the world.

missions.title: Missions
missions.subtitle: Real objectives across the world — speaking, listening, cases, duels and more. Progress updates automatically as you play; rewards land the moment you finish.

duels.subtitle: 1-vs-1 against another learner: the same questions, the same time, the result decided by the server.

adminUsers.title: Admin Users
adminUsers.subtitle: View and manage all registered ChineseVerse accounts.
adminUsers.cannotDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own admin account
adminUsers.confirmBody: This permanently deletes {{username}} and all of their learning data. This cannot be undone.
adminUsers.dbNote: Local and production are separate databases. This page lists only the database above; open Admin → Users on the other environment to see its users.
adminUsers.authNote: Sign-in shows Google once an account is linked to Google. Google accounts created before linking existed show Password until their next Google sign-in. Last activity is the latest recorded learning activity; there is no separate login log.

email.testOk: Test email sent to your own address. Check your inbox (and Spam).

email.renotifyHint: Unfollowing and following the same person again within {{hours}} h creates no new notification or email (anti-spam).

companionReact.proud: {{name}} is proud of you. Solid round!
companionReact.encouraging: {{name}} says: not quite — look at the answer, it will stick next time.
companionReact.worried: {{name}} can see this is tricky right now. Slow down — every miss goes to Review, nothing is lost.
companionReact.reviewClear: {{name}} is relaxed — your review queue is empty.
companionReact.lessonWords: Peek at this lesson's words (tap one to hear it)

cause.recovering: {{name}} perks up — you found your footing again. Keep going!
cause.hot_streak: {{name}} is thrilled — {{count}} in a row, you're on fire!
cause.comeback: {{name}} is proud — this one tripped you up before, and now you've got it.
cause.skill_up: {{name}} noticed: your {{skill}} just grew in your Learning DNA!
cause.miss: {{name}} says: not quite — look at the answer, it will stick next time.
cause.streak_break: {{name}} shrugs it off — one miss after a great run. Keep your rhythm.
cause.two_misses: {{name}} is a little concerned — slow down and read the answer carefully.
cause.mistake_run: {{name}} can see this is tricky right now. Slow down — every miss goes to Review, nothing is lost.
cause.long_slump: {{name}} is sitting right beside you. Tough stretch — take a breath; these will come back in Review.
cause.repeat_item: {{name}} gets focused — this {{noun}} has come up before. Let's look at it closely together.
cause.tricky_item: {{name}} huffs at this sneaky {{noun}} (not at you!). Say it aloud once and it will stick.
cause.self_known: {{name}} is happy you know this one.
cause.still_learning: {{name}} nods — an honest check. It will come back in Review.
cause.keep_practicing: {{name}} says: {{score}}% — good effort. Revisit the item below and try another round.
cause.needs_review: {{name}} is with you — {{score}}% this time. Your misses are waiting in Review; let's go over them.
cause.review_clear: {{name}} is relaxed — your review queue is empty.
cause.lesson_start: {{name}} is ready to learn with you. Meet this lesson's words first.
cause.review_start: {{name}} is focused — {{due}} items to bring back from memory.
cause.good_trace: {{name}} is happy — well written, just a slip or two.
cause.shaky_trace: {{name}} cheers you on — the character is done; one more trace will make it steadier.
cause.writing_mastered: {{name}} is celebrating — you can write this character now!
